domains.name: Deploy and manage Azure compute resources

tasks.name: Automate deployment of resources by using Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates or Bicep files
Provision and manage containers in the Azure portal
Create and configure Azure App Service

concepts.name: ARM templates and Bicep
concepts.description: Use declarative infrastructure as code to define, modify, deploy, export, and decompile Azure resource configurations.

concepts.name: Azure virtual machine configuration
concepts.description: Create VMs and choose sizes, operating-system/data disks, and related compute settings to fit workload requirements.

concepts.name: Virtual machine encryption at host
concepts.description: Protect supported VM temporary disks, caches, and data flows to storage with encryption performed at the VM host.

concepts.name: Moving Azure virtual machines
concepts.description: Distinguish same-region resource/subscription moves from cross-region migration and validate resource dependencies before a move.

concepts.name: VM availability zones and availability sets
concepts.description: Choose fault-isolation options that reduce exposure to datacenter or hardware maintenance/failure events.

concepts.name: Virtual Machine Scale Sets
concepts.description: Deploy and manage a group of load-balanced VMs that can scale capacity and maintain consistent instance configuration.

concepts.name: Azure Container Registry
concepts.description: Store and manage private container images and related OCI artifacts for Azure container workloads.

concepts.name: Azure Container Instances
concepts.description: Run containers directly in Azure without managing virtual machines or a full orchestrator.

concepts.name: Azure Container Apps
concepts.description: Run serverless containerized applications with revisions, ingress, environment boundaries, and event/HTTP-driven scaling.

concepts.name: Container sizing and scaling
concepts.description: Choose CPU/memory and scaling behavior appropriate to Azure Container Instances or Azure Container Apps.

concepts.name: Azure App Service and App Service plans
concepts.description: Host web apps and APIs on managed compute defined by an App Service plan.

concepts.name: App Service scale up and scale out
concepts.description: Change App Service compute tier/size or instance count to meet capacity requirements.

concepts.name: App Service TLS and custom domains
concepts.description: Map custom DNS names and secure HTTPS traffic with certificates and TLS settings.

concepts.name: App Service operations
concepts.description: Use backups, networking features, and deployment slots to operate and release App Service applications safely.
